subject.title: feat(ui): session unarchive flows with undo toast

question: Should the Control UI’s destructive archived-session action preserve literal “Delete all archived” semantics for archives larger than 1,000 rows?
rationale: The branch deliberately chooses a bounded fetch, while the product label presents an all-sessions operation; only maintainers can choose whether completeness or a bounded safety/performance contract is intended.

options.title: Implement complete enumeration
options.body: Page through every archived session before confirmation and delete the complete enumerated set so the action matches its label.

options.title: Expose the bounded scope
options.body: Retain the cap but rename the action and confirmation to state the exact fetched subset and leave remaining archived sessions discoverable.

options.title: Accept the capped all-action
options.body: Keep the current wording and cap as an intentional operational tradeoff, documented in the UI-facing contract.

recommendation.title: Implement complete enumeration
recommendation.body: Page through every archived session before confirmation and delete the complete enumerated set so the action matches its label.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed user-facing behavior and its stated 1,000-row tradeoff originate in this PR.
